paths.owning_subject: fix(money): close success-vs-safe-stop double-journal race in trade settlement (Step 7.2)

commits.subject: fix(money): close success-vs-safe-stop double-journal race in trade settlement (Step 7.2)

paths.reason: finalizeMatchSuccess/finalizeSafeStop previously posted their ledger journal (settlement:<tradeId> vs participate_unlock:<tradeId> - different idempotency keys) BEFORE the status-guarded claim UPDATE. Two concurrent executeTick calls racing on the same still-running trade could each decide a different terminal result and each post their own journal, double-crediting principal for one locked amount. Reordered both methods to claim the terminal transition first via the existing atomic single-statement UPDATE; only the winner may post a journal. Covered by the new trades.execution.race.selftest.ts (7 cases), independently confirmed to fail against the pre-fix code (git stash rollback + rerun) and pass against the fix.
